strengths.mechanism: Inspect lore before starting a Scenario; Character Creator separates player Notes from AI Entry.
strengths.benefitInference: Players may understand their premise and choices before beginning.

strengths.mechanism: Separate saved content types, search, bookmarks, Duplicate, and Trash Restore.
strengths.benefitInference: Players may find an exact story and protect experiments more easily.

strengths.mechanism: Direct text edit, Retry Stack alternatives, session Undo/Redo, and targeted empty-output diagnosis.
strengths.benefitInference: Players may correct a bad turn without abandoning the story.

strengths.mechanism: Editable Story Summary, Memory Bank retrieval, response-level context viewing, Inspect Input, and overflow warnings.
strengths.benefitInference: Players may diagnose why a story lost continuity and adjust relevant information.

strengths.mechanism: Model-switching shortcut with persistent settings per model.
strengths.benefitInference: Players may switch models while retaining preferred tuning.

tradeoffs.note: Undo cannot recover actions preceding a refresh. Retry may consume credits.
Story Card JSON import replaces all existing cards; backups are explicitly advised. Native iOS/Android apps lack this transfer workflow.
Context capacity depends on model and membership; controls vary by model.
Dynamic Small switches among undisclosed models and exposes only response length; this limits reproducible model selection and tuning.
Documented cloud play requires connectivity; offline play is explicitly unavailable.
Character Creator can generate inaccurate Plot Essentials; random Quickstart may combine incompatible options.
View Context is disabled after refresh or erasure until a new action.

unknowns.note: No live interaction, responsiveness, keyboard, touch, accessibility, output quality, or failure-recovery reliability was tested.
A supported self-hosted application and arbitrary external/BYOK model endpoints were not established. Offline unavailability is not proof that every self-hosting route is absent.
Durable checkpoint ancestry and a visual branch tree were not established by Duplicate or session Undo documentation.
Character-card compatibility, complete Adventure-state restoration, and cross-tool round trips were not established by JSON lore transfer or ZIP text download.
Voice selection, TTS, and dictation were not established in inspected sources.
Independent AI-character scheduling was not established by human multiplayer documentation.
Import documentation prose names useForCharacterCreator, while its JSON examples use useForCharacterCreation. Accepted spelling was not tested; do not treat this page as a validated schema.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Show premise and optional lore beside Start; separate player-facing explanation from AI instructions.
reusablePatterns.rationale: Makes scenario choices understandable before story creation.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Distinguish reusable setup from exact saved stories; expose duplicate and restore clearly.
reusablePatterns.rationale: Makes the consequences of starting, resuming, and experimenting explicit.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Connect each response to existing context inspection and capacity warnings.
reusablePatterns.rationale: Explains included information at the point where a continuity problem appears.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Keep model switching near play while preserving per-model advanced settings.
reusablePatterns.rationale: Offers a short common path without removing expert controls.

doNotCopy.pattern: Replacement-only lore import without preview, backup, and explicit replacement choice.
doNotCopy.reason: A valid import overwrites existing cards.

doNotCopy.pattern: Presenting session Undo as durable story history.
doNotCopy.reason: Undo loses access to actions before refresh.

doNotCopy.pattern: Random character selection without compatibility checks.
doNotCopy.reason: Official guidance acknowledges incompatible Quickstart combinations.

characterOnboarding.note: Create a Scenario or use community setup; Character Creator provides predefined character choices. Story Card JSON can carry character lore; standard character-card import compatibility is unknown.

storyOrganization.note: Account-saved Adventures and Scenarios are separate types with search, bookmarks, duplication, and Trash Restore.

editRetryBranch.note: Edit inputs/outputs, select Retry Stack alternatives, Undo/Redo within a session, or Duplicate an Adventure. Durable branch ancestry is unknown.

memoryLore.note: Keyword-triggered Story Cards plus Auto Summarization, editable Story Summary, and Memory Bank retrieval. Recall quality was not tested.

promptTransparency.note: View Context is attached to the latest response; Inspect Input exposes last sent text and Context Warning flags omitted components. Viewing is unavailable after refresh/erase until another action.

modelConnections.note: Select hosted models/versions through settings or shortcut; settings persist per model. Arbitrary external endpoints and BYOK were not established.

advancedControls.note: Context/response length, temperature, Top-K, Top-P, and penalties are documented. Availability varies by model; context also depends on membership.

groupRoleplay.note: Human multiplayer shares the host's model settings. This does not establish independently configured or scheduled AI character groups.

imagesVoice.note: See mode and an image-model selector are documented. Voice configuration, TTS, and dictation remain unknown.

mobile.note: Native iOS/Android and mobile web are documented. Story Card import/export requires web. No device test was performed.

portability.note: Story Card JSON import/export and ZIP Adventure-text download. Import replaces existing lore. Full state round-trip and character-card compatibility are unknown.

selfHosting.note: Documentation describes cloud models and explicitly no offline play. A supported self-hosted application/distribution was not established.
